item.name: scroll-showcase
item.summary: Scroll composition: StickyScrollStory + ScrollReveal + optional Marquee; all copy comes from props (DOM, reduced motion -> static/opacity, mobile -> stacked)

useWhen: Product feature narrative requiring sticky step progression and reveal on scroll
Product or engineering deep-dive with step-by-step media and an optional metrics grid
Multi-section storytelling with accessible scroll-driven reveals
avoidWhen: Short single-screen pages without scroll depth
Mobile web apps requiring dense vertical list views
Documentation sites where uninterrupted linear reading is essential

alternatives.name: sticky-scroll-story
alternatives.when: When you only need the sticky step column without accompanying feature grids or marquee

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When you only need basic reveal-on-scroll animations for individual cards

tiers.0: Not gated by tier: layout stacks at viewport width 768px and below; ScrollReveal content is static; Marquee is paused with no duplicate copy
tiers.1: ScrollReveal travel capped at 12px; Marquee still animates; layout depends on viewport width, not tier
tiers.2: Sticky story with CSS crossfades, scroll-linked or IntersectionObserver reveals, animated marquee

reducedMotion.description: StickyScrollStory swaps media instantly (no transition, no translation); ScrollReveal elements are immediately visible; Marquee stops animating and renders a static row (no duplicate copy, no pause button)

input.pointer: Hovering the marquee pauses it; the sticky story is driven by scroll position
input.touch: At viewport width 768px and below the story is stacked without sticky positioning
input.keyboard: DOM order matches visual order; the only added focusable element is the marquee pause button, and focus inside the marquee pauses it

a11y.notes: Sections are named through aria-labelledby (the headline, and the specs heading when you pass one) or aria-label (marqueeLabel when you pass one); ids are generated per instance with useId, so two sections on one page never clash. Heading levels run h2 (headline), h2 (each step title, from StickyScrollStory), h3 (specsHeading), h4 (spec labels): place the section under an h1 and check the outline for your page. media.alt applies only to media.type 'image'. Every colour is a host token (--background, --foreground, --primary, --muted-foreground, --card, --border) with a system-colour fallback; contrast follows your theme: measured on real pixels in a fresh Next 16 app with shadcn's default tokens (sample content, light and dark, 1440 and 390 px) every text element was at least 4.7:1 (light) and 6.9:1 (dark); verify your own content.

props.name: headline
props.effect: Required. Primary section headline rendered as an h2.

props.name: description
props.effect: Required. Section narrative description below the headline.

props.name: steps
props.effect: Required. Narrative steps for StickyScrollStory ({ id, title, description, badge?, media }).

props.name: eyebrow
props.effect: Optional. Eyebrow badge above the headline.

props.name: specs
props.effect: Optional. Specifications / highlights grid items ({ metric, label, detail }).

props.name: specsHeading
props.effect: Optional. Heading above the specifications grid. Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: specsEyebrow
props.effect: Optional. Small label above the specifications heading. Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: showMarquee
props.effect: Shows the marquee ticker when marqueeItems is non-empty.

props.name: marqueeItems
props.effect: Optional. Array of items to display in the marquee ticker.

props.name: marqueeLabel
props.effect: Optional. Label above the marquee ticker, also its accessible name. Nothing is rendered when omitted.

props.name: smoothScroll
props.effect: Wraps the composition in the SmoothScroll provider (off by default).

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop. Passed to the reveals, the story, the marquee and SmoothScroll (the reveals only react when the browser lacks CSS scroll-driven animation).

props.name: nonce
props.effect: Optional CSP nonce forwarded to the <style> element of every item the section renders.

props.name: className
props.effect: Optional. No default. Additional CSS class names on the root container. Any other HTML attribute (id, data-*, aria-*, event handlers) is spread on the root element; handlers the item uses itself are composed, not replaced.

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles on the root container, merged last (consumer wins).

mistakes: headline, description and steps are required and the component contains no copy of its own: nothing is rendered for specsHeading, specsEyebrow or marqueeLabel unless you pass them.
StickyScrollStory renders each step's media.content twice (a sticky column and a stacked mobile copy), so do not put ids inside it.
Do not enable smoothScroll on dashboards or documentation pages, and never when another SmoothScroll is mounted (a second one warns and does nothing).
Do not place multiple sticky scroll sections immediately adjacent to each other without spacing.
Under a nonce-based CSP pass nonce: it is forwarded to every <style> the section renders.
Reveal and marquee animations only run when <html> has data-motion="ok" (MotionReadyScript in Next, initMotionReady() in Vite).
verify: Verify that the step sequence is fully accessible in DOM reading order.
Verify that mobile viewports switch to stacked mode without sticky jumping.
Verify that reduced-motion preferences stop the marquee animation and reveals remain static.
